title: IELTS Academic 19 - Listening Test 1 - Part 2
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 2

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

07:53ANNOUNCER: Part 2. You will hear the Chairman of Stanthorpe Twinning Association, which organises the link between Stanthorpe in England and a town in France, talking to members about the year's events.
08:08ANNOUNCER: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 15.
08:48ANNOUNCER: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 15.
08:56SPEAKER: It's great to see so many members of the Twinning Association here tonight. Since the twinning link between our two towns, Stanthorpe here in England and Malatte in France, was established, the relationship between the towns has gone from strength to strength.
09:16SPEAKER: Last month, 25 members of the association from Stanthorpe spent a weekend in Malatte. Our hosts had arranged a great programme. We learned how cheese is produced in the region and had the chance to taste the products. The theme park trip had to be cancelled, but we all had a great time on the final boat trip down the river – that was the real highlight.
09:45SPEAKER: This is a special year for the Association because it's 25 years since we were founded. In Malatte, they're planning to mark this by building a footbridge in the municipal park. We've been discussing what to do here and we've decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum gardens. We considered buying a garden seat to put there, but the authorities weren't happy with that idea.
10:15SPEAKER: In terms of fundraising to support our activities, we've done very well. Our pancake evening was well attended and made record profits. And everyone enjoyed the demonstration of French cookery, which was nearly as successful. Numbers for our film show were limited because of the venue so we're looking for somewhere bigger next year.
10:43SPEAKER: We're looking forward to welcoming our French visitors here next week, and I know that many of you here will be hosting individuals or families. The coach from France will arrive at 5 pm on Friday. Don't try to do too much that first evening as they'll be tired, so have dinner in the house or garden rather than eating out. The weather looks as if it'll be OK so you might like to plan a barbecue. Then the next morning's market day in town, and that's always a good place to stroll round.
11:25SPEAKER: On Saturday evening, we'll all meet up at the football club, where once again we'll have Toby Sharp and his band performing English and Scottish country songs. Toby will already be well known to many of you as last year he organised our special quiz night and presented the prizes.
11:49ANNOUNCER: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions 16 to 20.
12:21ANNOUNCER: Now listen and answer questions 16 to 20.
12:28SPEAKER: Now on Sunday, we'll be taking our visitors to Farley House. You may not all be familiar with it, so here's a map to help you. You can see the car park at the bottom of the map. There's an excellent farm shop in the grounds where our visitors can buy local produce – it's in the old stables, which is the first building you come to. They're built round a courtyard, and the shop's in the far corner on the left. There's also a small café on the right as you go in.
13:05SPEAKER: I know that one or two of our visitors may not be all that mobile. The main entrance to the house has a lot of steps so you might want to use the disabled entry. This is on the far side of the house from the car park.
13:23SPEAKER: Children will probably be most interested in the adventure playground. That's at the northern end of the larger lake, in a bend on the path that leads to the lake. There's lots for children to do there.
13:39SPEAKER: There are a number of lovely gardens near the house. The kitchen gardens are rectangular and surrounded by a wall. They're to the north-east of the house, quite near the smaller lake. They're still in use and have a great collection of fruit and vegetables.
13:59SPEAKER: The Temple of the Four Winds is a bit more of a walk – but it's worth it. Take the path from the car park and go past the western sides of the stables and the house. Then when the path forks, take the right-hand path. Go up there with the woods on your left and the temple is right at the end. There are great views over the whole area. OK, so that's...
14:32ANNOUNCER: That is the end of Part 2. You now have 30 seconds to check your answers to Part 2.

groups.title: Questions 16–20
groups.instructions:
Label the map below.
Write the correct letter, A–H, next to Questions 16–20.

q11.text: During the visit to Malatte, in France, members especially enjoyed
options: A. going to a theme park.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (experiencing a river trip)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'we all had a great time on the final boat trip down the river – that was the real highlight.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Chuyến đi theme park bị hủy ('theme park trip had to be cancelled') nên loại A; thăm xưởng phô mai có diễn ra nhưng điểm nhấn thực sự là đi thuyền trên sông.

q12.text: What will happen in Stanthorpe to mark the 25th anniversary of the Twinning Association?
options: A. A tree will be planted.
B. A garden seat will be bought.
C. A footbridge will be built.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A (A tree will be planted)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'we've decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum gardens.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Cầu đi bộ (footbridge) là ở thị trấn Malatte bên Pháp; ghế làm vườn (garden seat) bị chính quyền từ chối ('authorities weren't happy with that idea').

q13.text: Which event raised most funds this year?

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (the pancake evening)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Our pancake evening was well attended and made record profits.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'made record profits' = raised most funds.

q14.text: For the first evening with the French visitors host families are advised to
options: A. take them for a walk round the town.
B. go to a local restaurant.
C. have a meal at home.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: C (have a meal at home)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'have dinner in the house or garden rather than eating out.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Khuyên KHÔNG đi ăn ngoài hàng ('rather than eating out' -> loại B); đi dạo thị trấn là sáng hôm sau ('next morning' -> loại A).

q15.text: On Saturday evening there will be the chance to
options: C. take part in a competition.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A (listen to a concert)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'meet up at the football club, where once again we'll have Toby Sharp and his band performing English and Scottish country songs.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Địa điểm là tại CLB bóng đá ('football club') chứ không phải xem trận đấu (watch a match); bài thi quiz (competition) là năm ngoái.
• Đáp án đúng: G
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'in the old stables... first building you come to... shop's in the far corner on the left.'
• Định vị: Từ bãi xe đi lên gặp Old stables. Đi vào sân trong, góc xa phía bên tay trái chính là G.
• Đáp án đúng: C
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'disabled entry. This is on the far side of the house from the car park.'
• Định vị: Car park nằm ở phía nam (dưới cùng). Phía đối diện xa nhất của ngôi nhà (far side) là phía bắc, chính là lối vào C.
• Đáp án đúng: B
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'at the northern end of the larger lake, in a bend on the path that leads to the lake.'
• Định vị: Hồ nước lớn hơn nằm bên trái (phía tây). Đầu phía bắc của hồ này, chỗ khúc cua của con đường chính là vị trí B.
• Đáp án đúng: D
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'rectangular and surrounded by a wall... to the north-east of the house, quite near the smaller lake.'
• Định vị: Hồ nhỏ nằm ở phía đông. Khu vườn hình chữ nhật có tường bao quanh nằm ở góc đông bắc của ngôi nhà chính là D.

q20.text: The Temple of the Four Winds

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'when the path forks, take the right-hand path. Go up there with the woods on your left and the temple is right at the end.'
• Định vị: Đi theo con đường phía tây qua nhà chính, đến ngã ba rẽ phải, đi men theo hàng cây bên trái lên trên cùng chính là A.
